datasets_and_splits: Fixed published mlearn train/test splits for Li, Mo, Cu, Ni, Si, and Ge; training-only model selection.
interpretation: Tagged YE3T adds measured force accuracy/runtime Pareto points; ordinary YE3T AUTO isolates pair-style execution on the same ACE model.
known_confounds: Mixed and symmetric series use different descriptor families.
The joint permutation/rotation causal ablation is currently Cu-60.
limitations: The result is CPU-only; composite tagged Kokkos currently fails closed.
AUTO choices are catalogue- and hardware-specific; the fitted catalogues selected compiled-direct on this CPU.
The tagged portfolio is catalogue-global rather than a per-descriptor mixed route schedule.
The current portfolio is the LegacyMomentV2 execution representation, not the complete V3 physical-image runtime.
matched_variables: Byte-identical ordinary .yace for PACE product and YE3T-symmetric; common cells, ZBL reference, precision, rank count, warmup, and timed steps.
primary_metric: held-out force RMSE versus measured one-rank CPU time per atom-step
statistical_test_or_interval: Five interleaved timing repetitions per retained row; fixed-test model errors.
